definitions: To perpetrate or carry out (a mistake, crime, or immoral act).
To pledge or bind (a person or an organization) to a certain course or policy.
To send (someone) to prison or to a psychiatric hospital.
To dedicate (oneself) to a cause, policy, or person.
To transfer (data) to permanent storage or to a database.
examples: He decided to commit the crime.
They committed themselves to the project.
The judge committed him to jail.
She committed to her new role.
pastTenses: committed (past simple), committed (present perfect), committed (past perfect)
